name: Class buffs: Descension of Ragnaros and Fire Protection count once for Fire resistance
contract: Class reviewer feedback 2026-11-22 (PR #13237): Descension of Ragnaros belongs with the Fire resistance
buffs, and Legionfel Pact stays out because of its curse and magic resistance. Descension of Ragnaros
1119901 (Pyromancer, class 24) is an endless raid area aura of SPELL_AURA_MOD_RESISTANCE_EXCLUSIVE Fire,
+30; Fire Protection rank 3 582535 (Guardian, class 18) is the same aura, +60, for 30 minutes. The aura
keeps only the highest amount per school, so neither needs a spell_group and neither loses its aura.
Expected: on a grouped warrior ally Descension raises Fire resistance by 30, Fire Protection lifts it to
60 rather than 90, and both auras stay.

steps.label: The Pyromancer takes on Descension of Ragnaros
SETUP: the Descension of Ragnaros aura reaches the ally
Descension of Ragnaros raises Fire resistance by 30
SETUP: the ally carries Fire Protection
Give the area aura updates time to try the ally again
CONTROL: Descension of Ragnaros stays next to Fire Protection
DISCRIMINATING: the two count once, Fire resistance rose by 60, not 90
